allowed_sentences: A composite ACTINV library, TENDL-2025 with 92 of the 214 target-reaction blocks measured in UKAEA's integro-differential validation table taken whole from TENDL-2017, TENDL-2023 or ENDF/B-VIII.1 by a fixed rule, scored a median |ln(C/E)| of 0.138 in a leave-one-facility-out test on the table's 193 rows whose reaction was also measured at another facility, against 0.160 with TENDL-2025 alone and 0.132 for FISPACT-II's published TENDL-2017 values; the block choice brought ACTINV closer to the measurements than TENDL-2025 alone (p = 4.6e-05), and neither ACTINV nor FISPACT-II was significantly closer (p = 0.99).

On data scored before with TENDL-2025, the composite's median |ln(C/E)| was: IRDFF-II's 120 spectrum-averaged cross sections, 0.020 against 0.020 (neither was significantly closer, 11 values changed, p = 0.13); the 29 Rez activation rates, 0.038 against 0.038 (neither was significantly closer, 3 values changed, p = 0.59); the 2,360 JAEA-FNS decay-heat points, 0.099 against 0.139 (the composite was closer, 2136 values changed, p = 1.8e-49).

None of these data was independent of earlier work: the table was compared with TENDL-2025 before (P192), the JAEA-FNS decay heat was measured at one of the table's three facilities, and the other two sets were scored before (P17, P167); in each fold of the table test the held-out facility played no part in the choice.
